findings.how_to_check: Run git status --short to observe ?? MATCHING/_run__tgt_only_run.do, and inspect line 1 to confirm the hardcoded path. Attempting to execute stata -b do MATCHING/_run__tgt_only_run.do from any directory other than D:\repos\fixing_transcription_errors will fail on the do command.
findings.suggested_fix: Do not commit MATCHING/_run__tgt_only_run.do; remove it from the working tree. In addition, add _run_*.do to .gitignore so temporary runner wrappers generated by replication/Run-Stata.ps1 do not pollute the working tree.
findings.title: Untracked Stata launcher hardcodes author-specific local repository path
findings.what_the_code_does: The launcher executes `capture noisily do "D:\repos\fixing_transcription_errors\MATCHING\_tgt_only_run.do"`, hardcoding the local machine's checkout directory instead of invoking the script relatively or through $REP_REPO.
findings.why_it_matters: As an untracked file marked ?? in the working tree, committing it breaks replication immediately on any machine where the repository is cloned to a different path or drive. It appears to be an uncleaned wrapper artifact left behind by an execution of replication/Run-Stata.ps1.

review_limits: No paper draft was supplied; claims-vs-code review was evaluated against script comments, markdown headers, and review/briefs/2026-11-17-profile-jw-sd.md rather than manuscript text.
External census and profile datasets reside outside the repository and were not queried, precluding independent numerical verification of the calculated standard deviations.
The Stata pipeline was not executed; verification was performed by static analysis of code logic and Stata semantics.
Review was scoped to the uncommitted working-tree changes and untracked files rather than a full-repository audit.
Identification properties of FamilySearch profile linkage (such as selection into profiles with recorded death months) cannot be assessed without access to the underlying population datasets.
structured_output.summary: The new spread-statistics block at the end of MATCHING/profile_names_jw.do is sound and faithfully mirrors the slide's sample and measure choices, asserting matched counts and paired differences across records. The only concrete defect is the untracked launcher MATCHING/_run__tgt_only_run.do, which hardcodes a local D: drive path; it should be deleted from the working tree and prevented from recurring by ignoring wrapper files in .gitignore.

summary.description: Two to four sentences. The overall state of the reviewed work and the single most important thing to fix. No preamble.

dimensions_reviewed.description: Which scope dimensions were actually reviewed in this run.

findings.description: Defects and concerns, ordered most severe first. Empty if none. Do not pad with stylistic observations.

severity.description: blocker: a reported result is wrong. major: a referee would demand it. minor: real but survivable. nit: cosmetic.

confidence.description: verified: traced in the source. likely: strongly implied but depends on unseen data. speculative: a question, not an established defect.

title.description: One line, stating the defect itself, not its category.

location.description: path:line, or path:line-line. Several may be comma-separated. Required: a finding without a location is not a finding.

what_the_code_does.description: Precisely what the code computes, quoting the relevant expression. Contrast with what it was evidently intended to compute.

why_it_matters.description: The consequence for a number or claim in the paper. If there is no consequence, the severity is nit.

how_to_check.description: A concrete command, tabulation, or count the author can run to confirm or refute this in minutes.

suggested_fix.description: The change, specific enough to act on. Do not apply it yourself.

verified_clean.description: Things explicitly checked that were fine. This is what makes a short findings list trustworthy rather than lazy.

evidence.description: How it was confirmed, with path:line where applicable.

review_limits.description: What this review could NOT establish: data not readable, pipeline not runnable, paper text unavailable, Stata semantics not verifiable by reading. Be explicit; silence here reads as false assurance.
